nodes.question: What challenge do contemporary Earth crises pose to common notions of sustainability?
nodes.answer: Contemporary Earth crises challenge ideologies that place humans at the center of existence and separate from nature, prompting a reevaluation of sustainability concerning Earth-based kinships.
